extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML prose, figure captions/images, supplementary DOC captions, and methods. Figure-only quantitative traces are not overclaimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lynronne-1 and Lynronne-3 are supported as membrane-permeabilizing peptides in MRSA USA300, with lipid-monolayer evidence indicating preferential interaction with bacterial membrane lipids; Lynronne-2 shows weaker permeabilization despite lipid-interaction context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact figure trace values were not digitized; claim is limited to the source-stated membrane/lipid interaction and qualitative comparative strength.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Serial sub-MIC passaging for 25 days did not produce decreased MRSA susceptibility to Lynronne-1, Lynronne-2, or Lynronne-3 in the reported assays, supporting a resistance-development context rather than a molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Lynronne-1, Lynronne-2, Lynronne-3 against MRSA strains

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=4:p=Par9; xml:fig=2:panel=b; supplementary_doc:Supplementary Figure S3c-d; xml:sec=14

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports reduced MRSA ATCC 33591 biofilm attachment and effects on established biofilms at source-stated concentration multiples, which is retained as a phenotypic antibiofilm activity context and not promoted to a molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Lynronne-1, Lynronne-2, Lynronne-3 against MRSA ATCC 33591 biofilms
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure panel values are not digitized into exact row values; no molecular biofilm pathway is asserted.
